project.name: DAO 4
project.description: The DAO interface and everything common to all storages (Java 8 and later, no dependencies). The storages come in the artifacts dao4-fs-serialization, dao4-hibernate and dao4-hibernate-jakarta. The test jar (classifier tests) contains an in-memory DAO for tests and the contract tests for DAO implementations. Start with the overview of the Javadoc jar.
